rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for deliberately omitting an item, step, or section.

example.english: This page is too long, so I decided to skip it.
example.traditional: 呢一頁太長，我決定跳過佢。
example.jyutping: ne1 jat1 jip6 taai3 coeng4 ngo5 kyut3 ding6 tiu3 gwo3 keoi5

rows.note: Use this for deciding not to attend an event; for skipping class specifically, 走堂 is also common.

example.english: I’m going to skip the meeting today and rest at home.
example.traditional: 我今日唔去開會，想留喺屋企休息。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 heoi3 hoi1 wui2 soeng2 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 jau1 sik1

rows.note: Use this for moving by hopping on one foot at a time, rather than omitting something or not attending.

example.english: The children skip on one foot in the park and have lots of fun.
example.traditional: 小朋友喺公園單腳跳，玩得好開心。
example.jyutping: siu2 pang4 jau5 hai2 gung1 jyun2 daan1 goek3 tiu3 waan2 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1
